primary_metric: sum of per-asset median total_load_ms (load + first_render when measured)
noise_rule: Reject |delta| < 3% of champion sum (~460ms) unless same direction on 8/10; always prefer same-machine control

experiments.hypothesis: I believe inputRange unpacking Packed.floatArray when min/max exist contributes eagle load time.

experiments.variance: 10/10 faster including non-animated BMW/stone/CD and first-render; eagle-only ~-58ms
experiments.rejection_reason: Corpus delta is warm-machine bias vs frozen champion; target-isolated signal inside noise. Branch exp/007-anim-minmax@00d40f5 not merged.

experiments.hypothesis: I believe writePrepared + GLTFAsset(url:) re-read of prepared bytes contributes load time; GLTFAsset(data:) removes that tail without skipping prepare.
experiments.implementation_summary: Keep prepared Data; load via GLTFAsset(data:options:). URL path for no-prepare. Retry to original URL.
experiments.variance: 10/10 faster; matches EXP-007 within 5ms; prepare path never executed on v1 corpus
experiments.rejection_reason: Hypothesis unmeasured on v1 (0/10 need prepare). Warm bias. Re-queue on corpus-v2 where realistic_animals triggers metal-rough prepare. Branch exp/005-prepared-asset-data@97b6e0a not merged.
